responsibility: This definition module declares a character-input utility that combines file reading with an explicit pushback stack and source-location tracking. It belongs to the gm2 lexical/parsing support layer and exports operations to open a file, consume or push back characters or strings, report errors and warnings with file/line context, query current line and column positions, and inspect the accumulated warning exit status.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the interface half of the PushBackInput pair: it exports the pushback/input, diagnostic, and position-query procedures without exposing the module state, whereas PushBackInput.mod contains the actual stack, filename, line/column, and warning-status management.
